You're the first artist I've ever supported to the point of creating a fan account and attending a fan meet. Honestly, I never thought I'd do these things for someone I didn't know personally. 

I didn't even watch your season of PBB, but I discovered you through a TikTok video and became curious. I’m still unsure what exactly made me a fan, maybe it's your looks, sincerity, or character? Or perhaps it was just magic. You have an aura that makes it easy to love and support you. You're authentic. 

I'm very happy I attended your fan meet and brought my sister, who also became a fan. It was my first time seeing you in person, and I chose to enjoy each performance instead of taking too many photos and videos. You didn't disappoint us, and you gave it your all. Your performances showed hard work and passion, and you made us happy, proud, and inspired. Congratulations to you and the whole team behind this event, you guys did a good job. 

I truly believe you're born to be in this industry, Dustin. You're destined to be a star. Grabe ang puso and commitment mo sa trabaho. 

Thank you for always appreciating and loving us. Please know that we've got your back. We'll always make sure our love and support are louder and bigger than any noise. As you said, 'Sama-sama tayo hanggang dulo.' Laban lang :)

More and more people are appreciating and loving you now.

I'm sure you'll achieve even more, so keep the fire burning, stay humble, and remain true to yourself. We're always rooting for your success and happiness. Don't ever doubt yourself or be afraid, we're with you on this journey. 

We love you, and you deserve every bit of your success. You'll always be our Chinito Boss Sikap of Quezon City, our Paps, our Dudu, our Dustin Yu! 💛💙💚
